doctrine: Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN. FINAL_SUPER_GREEN is forbidden unless all mandatory gates are resolved from authoritative DCE/equivalent evidence. Partner-required opportunities are excluded in SOLO_LEAN_ONLY mode.

results.title: Submission management and editorial services for the Irish Journal of Agricultural and Food Research
decisive_blockers: Mandatory average annual turnover for the last 3 years of at least EUR 250,000.
Mandatory insurance if successful: Employer's Liability EUR 13m, Public Liability EUR 2.6m, Cyber Liability EUR 1.5m, with Ireland in territorial/jurisdiction cover.
Pass/fail technical requirements cover a full hosted manuscript submission/publishing platform plus editorial production workflow, GDPR/security, migration, training and support.
Award criterion B2 requires relevant journal publishing/editorial/submission-management experience and proposed-team capability, with a minimum score threshold.
Contract term is 2 years plus up to four 12-month extensions (maximum 6 years).

results.title: Animation and Software Development
positive_gates: Open procedure; participation not reserved; GPA covered.
English procurement documents and English electronic submission.
No turnover threshold identified in the authoritative procurement documents reviewed.
No mandatory certification or named-team/CV requirement identified.
Award scoring: Price 50%, Understanding of Requirements & Brief 30%, Aftersales services & guarantees 20%.
remaining_risks: Scope explicitly includes onsite advisory as well as AR/WebAR/app deployment, animated/3D assets, testing, optimisation and rollout.
RFQ asks for appropriate insurance cover but does not specify the exact required policy limits, leaving an unresolved insurance detail.
Aftersales services and guarantees carry 20% of the score, so a credible 9-month support/guarantee model is needed.
Technical execution is broader than a simple website or content job; it remains lean only if SPM can genuinely deliver WebAR/software and onsite advisory without external capacity.

results.title: Υπηρεσίες Ανάπτυξης και Διαχείρισης λογαριασμών στα Μέσα Κοινωνικής Δικτύωσης (Social Media)
decisive_blockers: This is a direct-award invitation addressed specifically to Your Brand Grand I.K.E. / IMPRESSME in Athens, not an open invitation to SPM Business.
The document asks that named operator to submit the offer; SPM Business is not the invited economic operator.

learning_signals: Direct-award invitations that explicitly name a different economic operator must be rejected before DCE prioritisation in SOLO mode.
Hard turnover thresholds should be elevated to early RED gates when entity financial evidence is known insufficient.
Digital/creative titles still require scope-complexity checks for onsite, support and specialist software obligations before SUPERGREEN classification.
